scope: Unique recommended computational result baseline for revision; not a declaration of independent measurement validity.
stage3c_role: Retrospective policy-choice sensitivity only; do not replace Stage3B final coefficients with a variable-policy model.
source_priority: Exact registered archive member plus SHA256. File name or modification time alone has no priority.

formulae.mechanical_target: ((DD-DD_mean_train)/DD_sd_train - (GR-GR_mean_train)/GR_sd_train)/2; ddof=1; each fitting scope has its own TRAIN parameters
formulae.OCI_score: 100*(OCI_raw-OCI_raw_TRAIN_min)/(OCI_raw_TRAIN_max-OCI_raw_TRAIN_min); do not clip or refit scale on TEST/new records
formulae.grade_assignment: 0 Compact below lower boundary; 1 Medium at/above lower and below upper; 2 Loose at/above upper

feature_units.Color_S: 8-bit HSV saturation digital units, mean within filled contour
feature_units.Struct_num_gaps: count of 8-connected dark components with area >5 pixels
feature_units.Struct_gap_ratio: fraction of all dark pixels within filled contour; no >5-pixel filtering of numerator

amendment_rule: New source values, IDs, endpoint extraction or analysis rules require a new freeze ID, change reason and affected dependency list; never silently overwrite this baseline.

GR.definition: Force–Time Gradient, author-designated updated working definition
GR.raw_export_field: Gradient F-T 1:2 as reported in related chat
